# Jenasaro

Jenasaro is construction planning, production management and execution-control software for connecting project schedules with work readiness, field delivery and management analytics.

Canonical website: https://jenasaro.com/

## Core positioning
- Project planning
- Construction scheduling
- Production management
- Execution control
- Project controls
- Daily production planning
- Constraint and work-readiness management
- Milestone management
- Resource and team planning
- Construction analytics

## Platform capabilities
Jenasaro connects schedule logic and baselines, look-ahead planning, work readiness, daily commitments, planned-versus-actual execution, constraints, milestones, team capacity, subcontractor coordination, Primavera P6 import, drawing-based workfront planning and management project-performance analytics. Management views can include plan reliability/PPC, contractor KPIs, milestone trends, reasons for variance, constraint ageing, resource conflicts, escalation flags and report-ready summaries.

Lean construction, Last Planner, PPC and takt planning are supported methodologies within the broader planning and execution-control workflow.

Product enquiries: https://jenasaro.com/interest
Contact: info@jenasaro.com

## Additional product workflows

- Connected organisation trees show project leadership, departments, subcontractors, teams and workers. Users can inspect recorded person profiles, zoom, focus a team in full screen and print charts. Editing and contact information are subject to project permissions.
- Organisation, team, resource-loader and area-responsibility workflows use connected project records. Project structures and assignments should be reviewed when scope changes.
- Academy guided practice and feature-specific training preserve completion of unchanged sections. In-app release notices provide change summaries, Academy links, dismissal and reminder controls.
- This file is a public product summary, not a guarantee of search indexing or AI inclusion. No independent customer rating is asserted here.

- [3D model planning](https://jenasaro.com/3d-model-planning): Link objects from Navisworks FBX exports to construction activities and review status. Native NWD/NWC/NWF/IFC files are not supported.
- [Baseline and schedule control](https://jenasaro.com/baseline-schedule-control): Compare baseline intent with commitments and current status; review delays and selected-activity mitigation.
